st-ives.hp: Made-to-measure kitchens, wardrobes and bedrooms for St Ives homes, handcrafted in our Peterborough workshop.
st-ives.big: St Ives mixes Victorian terraces by the Great Ouse with modern homes on the newer estates, and we make furniture to fit both.
kp: St Ives is around 24 miles from our workshop, usually 35 to 40 minutes via the A1(M) and A14. We work across St Ives, Hemingford Grey, Hemingford Abbots and Houghton as part of our regular area, with design, manufacture and fitting all handled in-house.

St Ives is a riverside market town, known for its medieval bridge with a chapel at its centre. Homes range from period cottages and Victorian terraces near the Great Ouse to modern family houses on the newer estates.
st-ives.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 24 miles from St Ives. As well as St Ives itself, we design and fit in Hemingford Grey, Hemingford Abbots, Houghton and Fenstanton.
fq: Do you cover St Ives and the Hemingfords?
Yes. St Ives is about 24 miles from our workshop, usually 35 to 40 minutes via the A1(M) and A14, and we fit across Hemingford Grey, Hemingford Abbots, Houghton and Fenstanton too.
Can you make wardrobes for a loft or eaves bedroom?
Yes. Loft bedrooms are common in older St Ives houses, and wardrobes made to follow the roofline are one of our specialities.

ely.hp: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes and bedrooms for Ely’s characterful homes, designed and built in Peterborough.
ely.big: Ely’s period houses near the cathedral and its open-plan new homes need very different furniture, and we make both to measure.
kp: Ely is about 30 miles from our Peterborough workshop, usually 45 to 50 minutes depending on route and traffic. It sits comfortably within our 80-mile service area, and we schedule survey and fitting days so that our team can work full days on site without rushing.

Ely’s homes reflect the city’s long history: period houses and terraces around the cathedral and city centre, plus a growing number of modern homes on the newer developments around the edge of the city.
ely.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 30 miles from Ely. As well as Ely itself, we design and fit in Littleport, Soham, Witchford and Sutton.
fq: Do you travel to Ely for design visits and fitting?
Yes. Ely is about 30 miles from our workshop, usually 45 to 50 minutes depending on the route, and we also cover Littleport, Soham, Witchford and Sutton.
My home is listed or in the conservation area. Can I still have fitted furniture?

Usually, yes. Internal fitted furniture is normally straightforward, but changes that affect original fabric may need consent. We’ll raise anything like that at the survey so you can check with East Cambridgeshire District Council.

wisbech.hp: Bespoke fitted kitchens, wardrobes, bedrooms and storage for Wisbech homes, handcrafted in our Peterborough workshop.
wisbech.big: From Georgian houses on the Brinks to modern family homes, Wisbech rooms come in every shape, so we build to your measurements.
kp: Wisbech is around 23 miles from our Brassey Close workshop, normally about 35 minutes along the A47. We cover Wisbech and nearby villages including Walsoken, Leverington and Elm as part of our regular area, using the same in-house team for design, manufacture and fitting.

Wisbech has some of the finest Georgian streets in the region, especially along the North and South Brinks by the River Nene, alongside Victorian terraces closer to the town centre and newer homes on the edges of town.
wisbech.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 23 miles from Wisbech. As well as Wisbech itself, we design and fit in Leverington, Elm, Outwell and Friday Bridge.
fq: Do you cover Wisbech and the nearby villages?
Yes. Wisbech is about 23 miles from our workshop, normally around 35 minutes along the A47, and we also fit in Walsoken, Leverington, Elm, Outwell and Friday Bridge.
Can you fit furniture in a listed Georgian house?

Yes. Fitted furniture usually sits alongside original features without problems, but changes to original fabric may need listed building consent. We’ll talk this through at the survey so you can check with Fenland District Council.

grantham.hp: Made-to-measure kitchens, wardrobes and bedrooms for Grantham homes, designed, made and installed by our Peterborough team.
grantham.big: Grantham’s Victorian terraces, period houses near St Wulfram’s and large modern estates all need different furniture, and we make each one to measure.
kp: Grantham is around 30 miles from our Peterborough workshop, usually 35 to 40 minutes straight up the A1. That keeps it well within our regular area, so you get the same in-house design, manufacture and installation team as our Peterborough customers.
Grantham has a broad mix of homes: period properties around the town centre and St Wulfram’s Church, long streets of Victorian and Edwardian terraces, and larger modern estates on the edges of town.
grantham.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 30 miles from Grantham. As well as Grantham itself, we design and fit in Great Gonerby, Barrowby, Harlaxton and Londonthorpe, and across to Sleaford.
fq: Do you design and fit in Grantham?
Yes. Grantham is about 30 miles from our workshop, usually 35 to 40 minutes up the A1, and we cover Great Gonerby, Barrowby, Harlaxton and Londonthorpe too.
What works best in a Victorian or Edwardian terrace?
Fitted alcove wardrobes, kitchen storage that uses the full height of the wall and under-stairs cupboards usually turn narrow rooms into practical ones.

oakham.hp: Made-to-measure kitchens, fitted wardrobes, bedrooms, media walls and storage for homes across Oakham and the wider Rutland countryside.
oakham.big: Furniture built for the way Oakham homes are actually built.
kp: The right answer for a Grade II cottage near the Market Place is not the right answer for a new build in Barleythorpe, so every design starts with the house itself.

Older Rutland homes mean uneven walls, low beams and deep reveals. We survey to the millimetre, scribe panels to the plaster and keep cabinet heights sympathetic to the ceiling, so nothing looks forced into a room that predates it by centuries.
oakham.dp: Oakham sits at the centre of our Rutland coverage. If your village is not listed, it is almost certainly still within reach, so call and we will confirm in a minute.
fq: Do you cover Oakham and the rest of Rutland?
Yes. Oakham is roughly 25 miles from our Peterborough workshop, about 40 minutes via the A47 and A606, well inside our 80-mile installation radius.
Is the design survey in Oakham really free?
Yes, and there is no obligation. A designer visits your home, measures the room and discusses storage, style, appliances and budget.

cambridge.hp: Designed, handmade and installed for Cambridge homeowners, from Victorian terraces near Newnham to new-build estates in Trumpington and Cambourne.
cambridge.big: Every piece is designed around your home and made in our own workshop, not ordered in from a catalogue.
kp: Cambridge has more of a mix of homes than most cities, from Victorian terraces to new-build estates, and each one calls for a different approach.

Victorian terraces usually have a narrow, single-aspect kitchen at the rear, sometimes with a small extension. We focus on making every centimetre count, with slimline units, integrated appliances and full-height storage rather than fighting the room’s original footprint.
cambridge.dp: Cambridge sits comfortably within our 80-mile Peterborough radius, around a 45-minute drive from our workshop.
fq: Do you cover homes in Cambridge conservation areas?
Yes. We regularly design bespoke cabinetry for period and conservation-area homes across Cambridge.
How far is Cambridge from your Peterborough workshop?

Around 45 minutes by road, comfortably within our roughly 80-mile working radius. Every kitchen, wardrobe and piece of furniture is made in our Peterborough workshop and brought to Cambridge for installation.
